title: Google Event
statusNote: Active but restricted: events must be bookable by the general public and held at a physical location; online-event properties were removed in the June 2025 changelog. Ineligible: events needing membership or invitation, school-premises spectator events with minors, virtual-only events; one event per leaf URL; multi-day events need start and end dates.
notes: Not checked: previousStartDate requires eventStatus to be EventRescheduled; only the presence of eventStatus is checked.
Not checked: offers.validFrom is only needed on date-restricted offers.

location is a Place (set @type Place) with location.address (PostalAddress; a full street address, not just a city) and location.name (recommended, venue name only). eventStatus values: EventScheduled (default), EventCancelled, EventPostponed, EventRescheduled; never remove startDate when status changes. previousStartDate: if present you MUST also set eventStatus to EventRescheduled (and no other status). offers.availability values: InStock, SoldOut, PreOrder; offers.validFrom only required on date-restricted offers; offers.price lowest price incl. fees, 0 if free; offers.priceCurrency ISO 4217. organizer is Organization or Person. performer is Person or PerformingGroup. image: repeated ImageObject or URL, 1920px wide recommended, min 720px.
